page.overview:
What is Alderaanian refugee convoy?

Following the Disaster, a convoy of Alderaanian survivors aboard three GR-75 medium transports traveled to Fostar Haven in the hopes of evading the Galactic Empire, which was under orders from Darth Vader to destroy all remainders of Alderaan.

The convoy was discovered, and Commodore Rae Sloane sent Captain Lindon Javes of Helix Squadron alongside a blockade to Fostar Haven to eliminate the refugees. Javes, however, refused to kill innocent lives when he learnt about the Disaster and resolved to aid their escape.

The convoy was evacuated by Javes and Echo Squadron of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
